title: Vision-Language Models Suppress Female Representations Under Ambiguous Input
abstract: arXiv:2605.31556v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Alignment teaches vision-language models (VLMs) to avoid expressing demographic biases, and when gender is clearly visible they largely succeed. Far less is known about ambiguous inputs (a worker in full gear, a figure seen from behind), cases common in practice yet rarely studied. We find that minimal prompting pressure exposes occupation-gender defaults when prompting ambiguous input images, with models collapsing to male even for strongly female-stereotyped occupations. But do these outputs reflect what models actually encode internally? We introduce LALS (Latent Association Leaning Score), a zero-shot metric that projects visual-token activations into the model's text-embedding space to measure concept associations per token and layer. translated_title: 视觉-语言模型在模糊输入下抑制女性表征
translated_abstract: 对齐训练使视觉-语言模型（VLMs）学会避免表达人口统计学偏见，当性别清晰可见时，它们在很大程度上能够成功做到这一点。然而，对于模糊输入（如穿戴全套装备的工人、从背后看到的人影）——这类在实践中很常见却很少被研究的情况——人们知之甚少。我们发现，在处理模糊输入图像时，微小的提示压力就会暴露出模型的职业-性别默认设置，即使对于具有强烈女性刻板印象的职业，模型也会坍缩为男性输出。但这些输出是否反映了模型内部实际编码的内容？我们引入了LALS（潜在关联学习分数），这是一个零样本指标，它将视觉token的激活投影到模型的文本嵌入空间中，以测量每个token和每一层的概念关联。在涵盖15个职业、超过800张性别模糊图像和四个VLMs的实验中，内部表征与输出往往呈现系统性解耦：模型在内部常常编码女性关联……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出零样本指标LALS，揭示视觉-语言模型在性别模糊输入下输出偏向男性，但其内部表征往往编码女性关联，表明模型输出与内部表征存在系统性解耦。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LALS, a zero-shot metric revealing that vision-language models default to male outputs under gender-ambiguous inputs while internally encoding female associations, exposing a systematic decoupling between outputs and internal representations.
